element.description: any Input argument, can be of any type and shape.
constraints: Can be of any type and shape.

output.description: ------- bool True if `element` is a scalar type, False if it is not.

constraints: In most cases, np.ndim(x) == 0 should be used instead of this function for zero-dimensional numpy arrays.
